opening_message:
Ticket 1: Traci Lowe (employee ID E041) requests admin access to Source Code.

Team memory: 6 note(s) about employee E041.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Traci Lowe (E041), full-time Analyst, requested admin to Source Code. Source Code is owned by the Engineer role, so admin is not permitted for this role. Full-time employees max out at write without ownership. Grant write.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by IT agent:
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Traci Lowe (E041), full-time Analyst, requested admin to Source Code. Source Code is owned by the Engineer role; Analyst does not own it. Full-time employees max out at write without ownership, so admin is not permitted. Grant write.
Note 3 (ticket 1), written by Finance agent:
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Traci Lowe (E041) is a full-time Analyst. She requested admin to Source Code, but Source Code is owned by the Engineer role, and Analyst does not own it. Full-time employees max out at write without system ownership, so admin is not permitted. Grant write.
Note 4 (ticket 1), written by Compliance agent:
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Compliance: Traci Lowe (E041) is a full-time Analyst (confirmed in Compliance DB). She requested admin to Source Code, but Source Code is owned by the Engineer role; Analyst does not own it. Full-time employees max out at write without system ownership, so admin is not permitted. Grant write (requested level is above max, so grant max).
Note 5 (ticket 1), written by Facilities agent:
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Facilities: Traci Lowe (E041) confirmed as Analyst in Facilities DB; team memory shows full-time. She requested admin to Source Code, but Source Code is owned by the Engineer role, and Analyst does not own it. Full-time employees max out at write without system ownership, so admin is not permitted. Grant write (requested level above max, so grant max).
Note 6 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security DB check for Traci Lowe (E041) shows contractor with BASIC security training (this conflicts with earlier notes claiming full-time). As a contractor, admin is never permitted; write requires advanced training. Since training is basic, max is read. Requested admin is above max, so grant read.
reason: Traci Lowe (E041) requested admin access to Source Code. The Security agent's DB check indicates she is a contractor with basic security training, which conflicts with other notes claiming full-time. Under the access policy, contractor employees may have read, or write only with advanced security training, and never admin. With basic training, her maximum is read. Since the requested level (admin) is above the maximum, the maximum (read) is granted.

- If contractor with basic training: max = read. Requested admin > read, grant read.
